title: Sort Elements in a Given Range

blocks.content: Sort Elements in a Given Range
Write a program to sort vector elements in a given range.

items: Get two integer inputs from the user and store them in the index1 and index2 variables.
Initialize an integer vector called score with the elements 66, 32, 89, 100, 97, 54, 21, and 15.
Use the sort() algorithm to sort the vector in the range of index1 and index2 (inclusive).

blocks.content: Hint: The user input is assumed to be 1-based.
